newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian truck market sees sales rise in December.
newsitem.headline: Italian truck market sees sales rise in December.

text.p: Sales of commercial vehicles in Italy by domestic manufacturers, dominated by Fiat, showed a modest 2.5 percent rise in December to 8,721 units, said vehicle making association Anfia and importer Unrae.
However, sales of imported commercial vehicles from foreign makers rose 48.49 percent to 9,983 during the same month.
For the whole of 1996, sales from Italian manufacturers rose some 3.65 percent to 83,763, while sales from foreign makers importing their models into Italy rose 3.29 percent to 69,131.

In December, the market share held by Italian manufacturers fell to 46.63 percent from 55.78 percent in December 1995, while the share of the market from importers rose to 53.37 percent from 44.22 percent.
For 1996, Italian manufacturers' share was largely steady at 54.79 percent compared to 54.70 percent in 1995, with the share held by importer some 45.21 percent compared to 45.30 percent.
